_doc: Every piece of code in m8b that came from a file outside it, with the source's sha256 (raw bytes as read; sha256_lf with CRLF read as LF) and the lines copied or re-typed. Written by hand-run one-off scripts on 2026-10-01 (C:/tmp/m8b-edt/write_provenance.py, then scratch/add_provenance.py for the second attempt's constructions); corpus.py checks the _z3echo.py copy against its source, and every entry's source hash against the file as it is, on every run (check_provenance).

m8b/_z3echo.py.how: verbatim; ranges joined by two blank lines; the module-level imports of composite, skeptic-gf3/ism.py and skeptic-twostep/synth.py left out (these lines use none of them)

m8b/corpus.py scan1, scan4_occluded, sca.how: the same loops in the same order with the frozen method only (LeanBand and printing dropped); checked by reproducing the 'final' tallies of final/scans_all.json

m8b/corpus.py scan2.how: the same loop with the frozen method in place of common.run_all's candidates

m8b/corpus.py scan5.how: (a) and (b) with the frozen method; (c) has no truth

m8b/corpus.py z3_group_key, Z3GRID_MS, _.how: z3_job's construction of the z3grid rows and its truth, z3_tasks' grouping

m8b/corpus.py _z3_task (z3), set_real_an.how: load_t1, load_z3 and load_real's inputs to the method (bins, dt, t_arrival, half_width), as run_eval_final.py fed them; the ISM rows are read from final/dev/ism_rows.pkl as run_eval_final.py read them

m8b/corpus.py scan1 (scan_i12 and early_.how: the grid, its truth and its histogram as scan_i12.py builds them, scored with the frozen method; the dedup and the d >= 0.6 m cutoff kept for the scan_i12 run and dropped for the early run (which target's scan_i12.json shows); both checked row by row against their outputs

m8b/corpus.py scan2b (scan_i4b form).how: the same rows as run_scans.py's scan 2b, the method called with no meta as common.run_all calls it

m8b/corpus.py set_real_and_seeds (real_s.how: the seeds scan's rows with the method called with no meta (lines 41 and 46); a row whose result differs from run_scans.py's is scored both ways

m8b/corpus.py noise_probe.how: the configurations, the generator seed (11) and the draws in their order, the method called with no meta

m8b/corpus.py noise_probe (truth).how: noise_probe.py kept no truth: scan_i5.py's for the same configuration (lines 28-29)

m8b/corpus.py ablate_rows.how: gen_rows' grid and blocked rows, the method called with no meta (line 92); its t1 rows are the t1 set

m8b/corpus.py ablate_rows (truth).how: ablate.py kept no truth: scan_i12.py's for the grid rows (the infinite run's Definition-A EDT) and scan_i1_occluded.py's 0 dB at the first arrival for the blocked rows
